summary: Deterministic v0.3 acceptance passed on the latest target-branch tip, and all Crew-local safety checks completed without modifying the official Harness. Real DSH/Hub acceptance could not start because no runnable DSH CLI was available locally: npx-based CLI resolution stalled during package execution/dependency resolution, and the official loopback web endpoint was unreachable. Crew remains uninstalled in the dedicated isolated state.

tests.name: Task Contract validation
tests.evidence: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json -> VALID TASK CONTRACT (exit 0).

tests.name: Source revision and worktree safety
tests.evidence: Target branch test/v0.3-final-isolated-acceptance was fetched and already up to date at 28e989de7161587e14c69148cb559dfb1a23df5d; worktree was clean before validation and is clean apart from this authorized Result Contract.

tests.name: Deterministic repository tests
tests.evidence: node --test test/*.test.mjs -> 420 tests, 420 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped.

tests.name: Client build
tests.evidence: pnpm run build:client exited 0 and produced the client bundle; the generated tracked lib/client.js was restored because generated output is outside the authorized write scope.

tests.name: Isolated Crew installer safety surface
tests.evidence: Installer reports Crew DSH_HOME as ~/.config/dsh-crew/harness, profile dsh-crew, and Hub http://127.0.0.1:3210. install --dry-run, status, and uninstall --dry-run all exited 0; status reported the Crew plugin and integrations as not installed.

tests.name: Official Harness integrity before/after probes
tests.evidence: Non-secret metadata/hash comparison remained identical for .credentials.yaml (208 bytes, SHA-256 819FECDCBB0F3585...), settings.yaml (1332 bytes, SHA-256 B3C608B86311C10A...), profiles/web/package.json (185 bytes, SHA-256 207430228A8315C78...), and profiles/web/cordis.yml (223 bytes, SHA-256 C300DCF2EBC5F020...). No credential contents were read, printed, copied, or modified.

tests.name: Official Harness health before Crew installation
tests.evidence: No runnable dsh executable was present; npx --no-install could not resolve it, and npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh --version plus npx --yes --package @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh --help stalled with no output and were terminated. Official loopback checks to port 3080 were unreachable, so normal official web startup could not be verified.

tests.name: Genuine completed Hub/MCP worker and sanitized selection trace
tests.evidence: The Crew-owned DSH Hub could not be installed or started because the DSH CLI runtime was unavailable; no worker execution or selection_trace claim was fabricated.

tests.name: Live max_parallel and activation-boundary semantics
tests.evidence: Deterministic runtime-control tests covering raise/lower admission and live/session/restart boundaries passed within the 420-test sweep; the required real Hub exercise was blocked by the missing DSH CLI.

tests.name: Adaptive routing acceptance
tests.evidence: Deterministic adaptive-routing tests passed, including opt-in, bounded warming, explicit-priority preservation, process-local health, restart reset, and traceability; the real isolated Hub exercise was blocked by the missing DSH CLI.

tests.name: Structured failure-code propagation
tests.evidence: Deterministic propagation/classification tests passed in the repository sweep; a real Hub -> client -> attempt -> workflow chain could not be exercised without the DSH runtime.

tests.name: Readiness and catalog diagnostics
tests.evidence: Deterministic readiness/catalog tests passed, including informational hints remaining non-failing; live Harness catalog evidence was unavailable because the DSH Hub could not start.

tests.name: Standalone official execution
tests.evidence: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY was absent from the process environment. node scripts/smoke-real.mjs <repo> standalone exited 2 with the intended blocked-style message; official credential stores were not read.

tests.name: macOS smoke
tests.evidence: Executor platform is Windows, not macOS.

tests.name: Final isolated state
tests.evidence: Because real acceptance was blocked, the task-required safe state was preserved: setup status reports dsh-crew not installed, Codex integration not installed, and Claude Code integration not installed; no dsh-crew process remained.

tests.name: Result Contract validator
tests.evidence: The validator --stamp step is the next protocol step after this draft is written.

blockers: No runnable @deepseek-ai/dsh CLI was available locally; npx package execution/dependency resolution stalled, preventing official and Crew-isolated Harness startup.
Official web health could not be verified because the normal CLI was unavailable and loopback port 3080 was unreachable.
Real Crew Hub worker, live controls, adaptive routing, catalog, and end-to-end failure propagation gates could not be exercised without the isolated DSH runtime.
notes: official/default DSH state was treated as read-only; no official profile installation, removal, or configuration write was attempted
Crew-owned isolated home/profile/port were the only intended Crew targets: ~/.config/dsh-crew/harness, dsh-crew, and 3210
Only the Result Contract is authorized to remain as a tracked repository change; ACTIVE_TASK.json will be removed after validator stamping per the task contract
